heading: Long-distance telephone calls for Vice President
lead: Commencing January 20, 1949, the provisions of existing law relating to long-distance telephone calls for Senators shall be equally applicable to the Vice President of the United States.

notes.text: Codification Section was formerly classified to section 46d–1 of this title prior to editorial reclassification and renumbering as this section.
